title: The Queen of Sheba and Solomon's Splendor

questions.question: Why did the queen of Sheba come to Solomon?
options: To test him with hard questions
questions.correctAnswer: To test him with hard questions
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:1 (ESV): "...she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions..."

questions.question: How many of her questions could Solomon answer?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:2 (ESV): "...There was nothing hidden from Solomon that he could not explain to her."

questions.question: What was her reaction to Solomon's wisdom and prosperity?
options: There was no more breath in her
questions.correctAnswer: There was no more breath in her
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:4 (ESV): "...there was no more breath in her."

questions.question: What did she say about the reports she had heard?
options: The half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me
questions.correctAnswer: The half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:6 (ESV): "...behold, the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me..."

questions.question: How much gold came to Solomon in one year?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:13 (ESV): "Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold..."

questions.question: What were all of King Solomon's drinking vessels made of?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:20 (ESV): "All King Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold..."

questions.question: What was silver considered in the days of Solomon?
options: It was not considered as anything
questions.correctAnswer: It was not considered as anything
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:20 (ESV): "...silver was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon."

questions.question: What did the ships typically bring every three years?
options: Gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:21 (ESV): "...Once every three years the ships of Tarshish used to come bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks."

questions.question: Who sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom?
options: All the kings of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: All the kings of the earth
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:23 (ESV): "And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom..."

questions.question: How long did Solomon reign in Jerusalem over all Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:30 (ESV): "Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years."

questions.question: Where was Solomon buried?
options: In the city of David his father
questions.correctAnswer: In the city of David his father
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:31 (ESV): "...and he was buried in the city of David his father..."

questions.question: Who reigned in Solomon's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:31 (ESV): "...and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: What wood did the king make steps for the house of the LORD from?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:11 (ESV): "The king made of the algum wood steps for the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: Where are the acts of Solomon written?
options: In the history of Nathan the prophet, priesthood of Ahijah, and visions of Iddo
questions.correctAnswer: In the history of Nathan the prophet, priesthood of Ahijah, and visions of Iddo
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:29 (ESV): "...are they not written in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer..."

questions.question: What did Solomon give the queen of Sheba?
options: All that she desired, whatever she asked
questions.correctAnswer: All that she desired, whatever she asked
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 9:12 (ESV): "And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked..."

key_verse_text: But I did not believe the reports until I came and my own eyes had seen it. And behold the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me; you surpass the report that I heard.
